title: Fossil Findings: How 500-million-year-old sea creatures evolved spider fangs
description: Spiders, scorpions, mites, ticks, horseshoe crabs, and sea spiders all belong to a diverse group called chelicerates. This group is a branch of the arthropods — animals defined by their jointed limbs and external skeletons (the distinct crunch you hear if you accidentally step on one).
